past.name: Annual Mongolian Americans Cycling Challenge
past.description:
2026 Mongolian American Annual Cycling Challenge 🚴‍♀️
Location: Silver Lake Park Group Campground, Seattle, WA
Dates: June 20 – 22, 2026 Saturday through Monday

We’re excited to announce the return of the 2026 Mongolian American Annual Cycling Challenge!

We’re keeping our traditional event format:
• Day 1 — Road Event
• Day 2 — Time Trial Event
• Day 3 — Mountain Climb Event



Registration is now officially open! 
• $100 per participant
• $50 for all others who are not participating in the event
• Kids are free

What's covered in your registration fee:
• Cost for event activities and logistics
• Campground reservation
• Closing day medal ceremony dinner (Khorkhog)
• Medals, trophies, and prizes
• Snacks and soft drinks during the event activities

What's not covered in your registration fee:
• Food and drinks (breakfast, lunch, dinner)
• Camping gear
• Transportation

Registration Link: https://forms.gle/sjfcFrtRYtGkTbQr5
Once you complete the registration form, click here 👉 https://cash.app/$NomadCyclingClub or Ticket link below to pay via CashApp. Please make sure to provide your full name in the memo section. 

Remember, all participants must sign the waiver!!!

⸻
Accommodation:
This year all events will be held in one convenient location. We have a group campground reserved for everyone for 4 days.

🏕️ Campground Information:
Reservation is from June 19 – 23rd. This is the same campground we've had the previous Mountain events. All camp sites have water and electricity. There's a clean vaulted bathroom on site, and a very modern clean bathrooms and showers in the adjacent campground about 3 mins walk north.

Registered participants are welcome to check in a day before the race begins on the 19th, so please keep this in mind while planning your trip. Campground check-in time is 3pm.

First come first serve format for tent spots within the group campground, but visitors from out of state get the preference of their choices first. Local to WA participants, please show this courtesy to the visitors.

There’s no cellular service available at the campground, make sure you have the address and directions available to you before you leave. 
We'll provide internet via StarLink for FIFA viewing and other event related business, but not for streaming videos. Don't have the bandwidth handle all that.

Directions from I-5 Northbound: 
Take I-5 Exit 255. Turn east onto Sunset Drive, toward Mount Baker (right turn for northbound, left for southbound)
Sunset Drive becomes Mount Baker Highway (WA-542 E)
Follow 542 E toward Maple Falls for 28 miles
Turn left onto Silver Lake Road and travel 3.5 miles before turning right into Group Campground.
Look for a small sign says, "Group Campground" on your right, and we'll also put a marker (Nomad CC flag) on the Silver Lake Road indicating for the turn.

Address: Silver Lake Park Group Campground 
8894 Silver Lake Rd, Maple Falls, WA 98266, United States

If anyone wants to come early or stay longer at the campground. please go to https://www.whatcomcounty.us/3518/Camping-at-Silver-Lake-Park to book your individual sites before or after the tournament. there are 3 x sites that can be booked online via link above. Maple creek is the one adjacent to the group site.

⸻
⚠️ Course Information:

Day 1: June 20th - Group Road Event: 
• https://www.strava.com/routes/3498356126124427880 
• 40- 3x Loops with U-turn at the start and finish
• 40+/50+ 2x Loops 
• Women Single loop 18 miles

Day 2: June 21st - Tim Trial Event: 
• https://www.strava.com/routes/3498355656796776564
• 13 miles with one U-turn

Day 3: June 22nd - Mountain Climb Event: 
• https://www.strava.com/routes/3498357652747027182
• Majestic Mount Baker
• Start from Chair 9 and finish at Artist Point parking lot entrance
⸻

🍽️ Event Details
Fuel your own adventure! Participants are encouraged to bring their own meals and snacks throughout the event days. To cap off an incredible weekend, we’ll be celebrating together with a special closing night dinner, podium ceremony, and celebration party.

⸻
👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Family & Community Activities
This year, we’re putting extra focus on families and kids as well! 

Activities will include:
• Family-friendly games and activities
• Community hangouts
• Poker games
• Watch FIFA World Cup games together

More updates will be shared as we get closer to the event.
Good luck with your training, have fun, and we can’t wait to see everyone again
